title: 第11章 惨烈第12章 用他的菊花为你祷告
content_zh:
第11章 惨烈
“我会选一根上好的长枪，”用很平静的语调：“从你这贱人的菊花里捅进去！”
稳稳的拔起插在地上的新手剑，只一瞬间，所有神赐士兵，就按预设好的布置，出现在林天的周围：最前派是40名强壮的矮人，紧接着的是54名长枪兵。由于身高关系，只有1米1的矮人可以直接攻击敌人的下盘，而长枪兵身高1米7再配上长武器，隔着矮人部队也可以直接攻击敌人上路，这批士兵组成严密整齐的阵形，直接显现在前排，甚至与少部分靠前的捕奴队员面对面的亲密接触。不同于捕奴队员的慌乱，矮人和长枪兵们在第一时间递出了自己的战斧和长枪，数名敌人顿时死亡或重伤。
与之同时行动的是后排的40名弓箭手和60名花妖，动作迅速的他们刚被召唤出来，立刻遵照指示行动。
花妖全体向敌人释放技能蜂群滋扰，这些蜂群虽然杀伤力不高，但骚扰的效果，却让捕奴队无法短时间组织起象样的攻击。
而弓箭手刚一出现，就被恨极了的林天严令，集中攻击了正在施暴的雷奥，40根突袭的密集铁箭，没有给雷奥留下任何反应的空间和反抗余地，密密麻麻的箭矢瞬间就插满了雷奥和小精灵的身体。小精灵当场死亡，愿这个可怜的孩子安息吧，死亡对她来讲，或许是一种解脱！
尽管5级剑士雷奥生命力很强大，战士铁甲防御也很高，但象现在这种，他自己解除了武装的情况下（他之前为了便于施暴，自己脱下了护卫下半身的铁护腿），在如此密集3级战力（再次强调，2阶神赐兵种相当于大陆3级战力）的打击之下，特别是屁股和下身部位，被报复心极重的某宅重点照顾，被射的跟刺猬一样，下半生的幸福是别想了，即便他再强，也立刻处于重伤濒死状态，这个罪恶的家伙没有高级炼金药剂，也没有我的小瓶红药，除了等死，只能倍受煎熬的苟延残喘……报应来的如此之快！
不过林天暂时没空理会他，敌人那位4级魔法师，用火盾术摆脱了蜂群滋扰后，一枚大火球锁定了他直射而来。而同样林天的大火球正在准备之中，虽然目标正是这个敌人，但眼下被人家先手了，躲避显然来不及……
“砰！”
火星四溅，4级大火球的爆炸让他感觉到一阵热浪袭来。不对啊，就这点热度？4级魔法伤害怎么也不至于这么差吧？咬牙将大火球丢向对手后，定睛仔细一看，原来是一只花妖主动飞过来，有她幼小的挡住了火球，现如今她已经变成了一具焦黑的尸体，某宅虽然已经有了士兵大规模损失的心理准备，但此时也不禁一阵心里疼，更加感激这救了自己一命的忠诚战士。
锐利的破空声袭来，另一只花妖也主动过来挡住了这必杀的一箭，她毫无意外的被利箭穿透了胸膛，香消玉陨。偷袭的正是4级弓箭手里奥。
在战场上分神就是自取灭亡，林天在这残酷的战斗中领悟到了这一点。
他放弃了部队的指挥权，并且迅速后退。
这并不是放弃战斗承认失败，相反是经过冷静考虑的：神赐战士拥有智慧，他们自己能够根据战况自主判断，且他们个个都是经验丰富的职业战士，有着准确的战斗本能，而这些都不是只看过点军事小说的死宅男可比的。让某宅去指挥他们，无疑是让外行去指挥内行，不客气的讲就是瞎指挥！就如同刚才，愤怒的林天强制命令所有的40弓箭手集中攻击5级战士雷奥，解气是解气了，但这些攻击力无疑是过饱和了，冷静下来估计30名弓箭手齐射，就能让他失去战斗力，而其他的10名攻击力就浪费了。另外一次性就将60个蜂群滋扰全都释放了出来，极短时间内上造成了敌人混乱，不过蜂群伤害小，对战士职业伤害很低，其最主要的作用是能干扰法师释放魔法。
你看目前场上就有一个长枪兵，被缓过神来的敌人法师，释放的小火球给干掉了……就目前而眼，什么也不做，也比瞎指挥要好！当然了，指定优先攻击目标、强令重伤战士后撤还是可以做到的。
林天的主职业是骑士，能给部队提供攻防加成，这就是他存在的巨大价值，不然凭什么2阶相当于3级战力的矮人，能勉强顶住4级敌人的亡命进攻？而他的副职业魔法师，可以在后方安全的释放魔法。保住自己的性命，这就是对部队最好的支援。
虽然他也可以释放无属性的魔法神箭，但没有四系能力的加成，魔法神箭的伤害还不如大火球，所以某宅在最后派站定，开始卖力的释放大火球。
战况极其惨烈，虽然神赐士兵数量占优（这里需要除开花妖部队，她们由于攻防太弱，加入战团基本就要全灭。本身又很有保留价值，所以放完1次蜂群滋扰后，就在弓箭手前面采取了防御态势），但平均等级比对手低了1级，受到等级上的压制……
捕奴队是怎么一批人？这就是一批亡命之徒，你可以说他们肮脏，罪恶，但你不得不说，他们是勇敢铁血的战士，一直就拿生命在赌博的他们，亡命的冲击林天的战阵。
最前排的40矮人承受了最大的冲击，已经损失过半了，即使林天很用心的想要用意念微操，把他们从死亡线上拯救出来，但死亡线为什么会称之为死亡线，因为这里退无可退。

1个矮人刚刚砍死眼前的3级战士，自身重上，林天只来得及用意念告诉他，你准备后撤了，但下一秒就被1个4级战士一刀剖成两半；1个长枪兵刚瞅准机会捅穿1个敌人，就被一枝流矢射成残血，林天及时用意念命令他后撤，但片刻之后他放弃了，这个可怜的长枪兵被远处锁定他的火球，给烤成焦碳；然而同一时间，这个3级凶手魔法师也被数枝精准的铁箭夺去了生命，委顿跌坐在原地。
弓箭手在与敌人远程部队的对撼中，虽然也死了不少弓箭手，但好在有前排的花妖舍身，也帮他们吸引了不少火力，现在完全压制了对手。随着这些王牌射手集中射击，捕奴队的高级战士和魔法师相继阵亡，剩下的8个战士集体崩溃，纷纷准备夺路而逃。面对这些玩弄智慧生命的人族败类，林天一个没打算放过，命令部队散开阵形全力追杀……
罪恶的蛆虫就由我来终结！
content_en:
Chapter 11 Tragic
"I will choose a good spear," in a very calm tone: "Poke it through your ass, bitch!"
Steadyly pulling out the novice sword stuck on the ground, in just a moment, all the god-given soldiers appeared around Lin Tian according to the preset arrangement: 40 strong dwarves were at the front, followed closely by 54 spearmen. Due to their height, only 1.1 meter dwarves can directly attack the enemy's lower body, while the pikemen, who are 1.7 meters tall and equipped with long weapons, can also directly attack the enemy on the road through the dwarf troops. This group of soldiers formed a tight and neat formation, appeared directly in the front row, and even had close contact with a small number of slave catchers in the front. Different from the panic of the slave catching team members, the dwarves and spearmen immediately handed over their battle axes and spears, and several enemies were immediately killed or seriously injured.
Taking action at the same time were the 40 archers and 60 flower demons in the back row. They acted quickly as soon as they were summoned and immediately followed the instructions.
The flower demons all unleashed the swarm nuisance skill on the enemy. Although these swarms were not very lethal, the harassment effect made it impossible for the slave catching team to organize a decent attack in a short time.
As soon as the archer appeared, Lin Tian, ​​who hated him so much, ordered him to focus on attacking Leo who was committing violence. The 40 sudden iron arrows did not leave any room for Leo to react or resist. The dense arrows were instantly filled with the bodies of Leo and the elf. The elf died on the spot. May this poor child rest in peace. Death may be a relief for her!
Although the level 5 swordsman Leo has a strong vitality and a warrior armor with high defense, like now, when he has disarmed himself (he previously took off the iron leggings that protected his lower body in order to facilitate violence), under the attack of such a dense level 3 combat power (again, the level 2 god-given arms are equivalent to mainland level 3 combat power), especially the fart The buttocks and lower body parts were taken care of by a certain house who was extremely vindictive. He was shot like a hedgehog. Forget about happiness in the second half of his life. No matter how strong he was, he was immediately seriously injured and on the verge of death. This sinful guy did not have high-level alchemy potions or my small bottle of red medicine. In addition to waiting for death, he could only linger in suffering...retribution came so quickly!
However, Lin Tian had no time to pay attention to him for the time being. After the enemy's level 4 magician used fire shield to get rid of the swarm of swarms, a fireball locked onto him and shot straight at him. Lin Tian's fireball is also being prepared. Although the target is this enemy, it is now attacked first, and it is obviously too late to avoid it...
"Bang!"
Sparks flew everywhere, and the explosion of a level 4 fireball made him feel a wave of heat. No, just this little heat? Level 4 magic damage isn't so bad, right? After gritting his teeth and throwing the fireball at his opponent, he took a closer look. It turned out that it was a flower demon flying over on its own initiative. It was her young body that blocked the fireball. Now she has turned into a charred corpse. Although a certain house has been mentally prepared for the large-scale loss of soldiers, it can't help but feel a pang in its heart at this time, and is even more grateful to this loyal soldier who saved his life.
A sharp sound broke through the air, and another flower demon also took the initiative to block this fatal arrow. Without any surprise, she was pierced through the chest by the sharp arrow, and her fragrance disappeared. The one who made the sneak attack was Leo, the level 4 archer.
Being distracted on the battlefield is self-destruction. Lin Tian realized this in this cruel battle.
He relinquished command of his troops and quickly retreated.
This does not mean giving up the battle and admitting defeat. On the contrary, it is based on calm consideration: God-given warriors have wisdom, and they can make independent judgments based on the battle situation. Moreover, they are all experienced professional warriors with accurate fighting instincts. These are not comparable to otakus who have only read some military novels. Let a certain house command himWe are undoubtedly letting laymen command experts. To put it bluntly, we are giving blind orders! Just like just now, the angry Lin Tian forced all 40 archers to attack the level 5 warrior Leo. He relieved his anger, but the attack power was undoubtedly oversaturated. Calm down and estimated that a volley of 30 archers would make him lose his combat effectiveness, while the other 10 attack power would be wasted. In addition, all 60 swarm nuisances were released at once, causing chaos to the enemy in a very short period of time. However, the swarm did little damage and did very little damage to the warrior profession. Its main function was to interfere with the release of magic by mages.
You see, there is currently a spearman on the field. He was killed by the small fireball released by the enemy mage who had recovered from his injuries... For now, doing nothing is better than blindly commanding! Of course, it is still possible to designate priority attack targets and force seriously injured soldiers to retreat.
Lin Tian's main profession is a knight, which can provide offensive and defensive bonuses to the troops. This is the huge value of his existence. Otherwise, how can a dwarf with level 2 equivalent to level 3 combat power be able to barely withstand the desperate attack of level 4 enemies? And his sub-professional magician can safely release magic from behind. Saving your own life is the best support for the troops.
Although he can also release magic arrows without attributes, without the bonus of the four-series abilities, the damage of the magic arrows is not as good as that of the big fireballs, so a certain man took his position at the end and began to release the big fireballs with all his strength.
The battle situation was extremely tragic. Although the number of god-given soldiers was superior (the flower demon troops needed to be eliminated here, because they were too weak in attack and defense, they would basically be wiped out if they joined the battle group. They were also valuable to preserve, so after releasing a swarm of nuisances, they adopted a defensive posture in front of the archers), but the average level was 1 level lower than the opponent, and they were suppressed by level...
What kind of people were the slave-catching team? This is a group of desperadoes. You can call them dirty and sinful, but you have to say that they are brave and iron-blooded warriors. They have been gambling with their lives and desperately attacked Lin Tian's battle formation.
The 40 dwarves in the front row bore the greatest impact and had lost more than half of their lives. Even if Lin Tian tried very hard to use his mind to micro-manage them to save them from the death line, why is the death line called the death line? Because there is no retreat here.
A dwarf had just hacked to death the level 3 warrior in front of him, and when he got up, Lin Tian only had time to tell him with his mind that he was ready to retreat, but the next second he was cut in half by a level 4 warrior; a spearman just saw the opportunity to pierce an enemy, and was shot to pieces by a stray arrow. , Lin Tian promptly ordered him to retreat with his mind, but he gave up after a moment. The poor spearman was burned into charcoal by the fireball locked on him from a distance; however, at the same time, this level 3 murderous magician was also killed by several precise iron arrows, and fell to the ground.
Although many archers died in the confrontation with the enemy's long-range troops, fortunately, the flower demon in the front row sacrificed his life, which also helped them attract a lot of firepower, and now they completely suppressed their opponents. As these ace shooters concentrated their fire, the senior warriors and magicians of the slave-catching team were killed one after another. The remaining eight warriors collectively collapsed and prepared to flee. Faced with these scum of the human race who were playing tricks on intelligent life, Lin Tian did not intend to let go of any of them, and ordered the troops to spread out and pursue them with all their strength...
I will put an end to the maggots of sin!
